rules.statement: A tenant is entitled to a full or partial refund of rent in cases where a vis major or casus fortuitus has prevented him from using the property for the purposes for which it was leased, either completely or to a significant extent.
rules.supporting_quote: The Appellants are thus entitled to the relief claimed. Page 20 of 20 I set aside the judgment of the High Court dated 25th May 2016 and affirm the judgment of the District Court dated 27th July 2012. The learned District Judge of Matara is directed to enter decree accordingly. Appeal allowed. Parties shall bear their costs.
